outcome: Add physics-based core-sensor classifier that overrides firmware VirtualCoreSensor when a combined heat-slowness + cool-slowness score indicates a different sensor is the true core. Mirror the existing surface-sensor correction pattern.
success_metric: wonder white CSV's core sensor role resolves to T6 (or T5) after classifier runs, not T1 (firmware pick); the 3 original real CSVs either retain firmware's core pick or change to a sensor with a stronger combined score; all 15 curve-boundary tests still green
constraints: TDD non-negotiable; DRY; same branch refactor/curve-boundary-detection
Do not modify curve extraction logic or existing surface-sensor classifier
Override firmware VirtualCoreSensor only when confidence threshold is exceeded (configurable, default TBD)
out_of_scope: Cross-CSV validation against additional real CSVs (we only have wonder white for ground-truth)
stop_criteria: Wonder white core resolves to T6 (or T5) AND all 15 boundary tests green AND no new full-suite regressions
handoff_artifacts: New or updated core-detection logic in src/data/
Fixture extensions with expected_core_sensor annotations + methodology docs
